headline: Rain tonight into Saturday morning, then cooler and mostly dry into next week.
summary: Warm weather ends tonight as a front moves in from the Pacific. Most rain falls late tonight into early Saturday, mainly on the coast and in the mountains. A ridge of high pressure that kept things warm is moving east, letting the front in. Showers may linger near the Snohomish and King county line after it passes. Saturday cools to the upper 50s and lower 60s, and Sunday is cooler and mostly dry. Next week looks mostly dry. A system offshore Monday should barely clip the area, bringing at most a shower or two on the coast. Tuesday brings light offshore winds and highs in the upper 50s. A weak front may bring rain Wednesday into Thursday, though that is less certain. Coastal waves will be rough Saturday.
